t: Fiesch-Eggishorn (2025) - All You Need to Know BEFORE You Go (with Reviews)
s: From Fiescheralp we took the cable car to Eggishorn from where we could see the beautiful Aletsch Glacier. I could even spot a Ferrata trail that takes you all the way up there. It is said you can even spot the Matterhorn from this point but we were still under the influence of the sands from Sahara so it was quite murky. I guess it is best to come see this spot in summer. When buying a gondola ticket, pay attention: sometimes the cashier does not have the head-set on and does not hear you.

t: Hike - Eggishorn to Bettmeralp alongside the Aletsch Glacier - Ali on Switzerland
s: July 31, 2025 - Stepping out of the cable car station at the top to see the glacier stretching out before you is a stunning sight. You can see all the way up to Jungfraujoch at the top of the glacier.
